textField:
To make a sprite walk or turn on the stage, we use the blue *motion* blocks.
If we want our character to pause for a moment before speaking, we use a *wait* block.
Most Scratch games and stories begin by using the *when green flag clicked* event block at the very top.
If we want a character to disappear completely from the screen, we use the *hide* block.
To make a character appear again after being invisible, we use the *show* block.
If our sprite is too big or too small for the background, we can adjust it using the *change size* block.
To make a sprite look like it is walking or dancing, we can put the *next costume* block inside a loop.
